description:
First rendering work: display the git history of a v0.1-shape conversation repo as a tree view. Per ARCH §7.1.

=== What to build ===

- Pure-Rust view-model module: 'GitTree::from_repo(repo_root: &Path) -> Result<GitTree, Error>'. Reads git history (via git2 / libgit2), produces a view-model describing commits, parents, branches, refs. Pure function of FS state at the current ref. No egui dependency.
- egui widget that renders GitTree as a visual tree view. Thin — all logic in the view-model.
- For v0.1-shape repos: the 'tree' is a linear sequence of commits on main, each with an exchanges/<ts>-<short-id>.json. Render each commit with its timestamp + exchange id + a truncated user-message preview read from the JSON.
- Extends naturally to v0.2 (branches) and later without rewriting the view-model.

=== Out of scope ===

- Live updates — wired via fs watcher in a later task.
- Click-to-focus navigation — deferred.
- Streaming-text indicators — deferred.

=== Dependencies ===

- Blocks on bl-1013 (UI skeleton).
- Soft-blocks on bl-ea1d (fs watcher) for live updates — initial version renders once at startup.

=== Testing ===

- Fixture repos under 'tests/fixtures/v01/' — small, hand-constructed real lernie repos (not mocks).
- Test via 'GitTree::from_repo(fixture_path)' returning expected view-model.
- egui render test: construct GitTree with known shape, run one frame in a headless egui::Context, assert output contains expected text.
- 100% line coverage on view-model functions.
title: UI: git-tree renderer for v0.1-shape repos
